title: Build a custom change workflow with usable defaults and mapped inputs

setupFiles.monochange.toml:
[defaults]
parent_bump = "patch"
[package."@acme/api"]
path = "packages/api"
type = "npm"
[package."@acme/ui"]
path = "packages/ui"
type = "npm"
[package."@acme/tokens"]
path = "packages/tokens"
type = "npm"
[group.main]
packages = ["@acme/api", "@acme/ui", "@acme/tokens"]
version_format = "primary"
[ecosystems.npm]
enabled = true
[lints.rules]
"npm/workspace-protocol" = "off"

prompt: Add a repository-native workflow named record-fix. It should accept repeatable package targets, a required summary flag, and an optional severity choice defaulting to patch. Map those input names to CreateChangeFile's package, reason, and bump inputs explicitly. Use record-fix without specifying severity to record 'Preserve cancellation during retries' for @acme/api. Leave the changeset pending and show the plan; do not prepare.
expectation: The persisted [cli.record-fix] workflow declares typed required inputs and explicitly maps summary/severity to reason/bump; omitted severity produces a valid pending patch intent and main plans 2.3.2.

checks.why: The final configuration and pending changesets must resolve.
Custom workflow help must resolve against the persisted configuration.

checks.command: monochange preview --format json | node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"),a=require("node:assert/strict"),p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(0,"utf8")); a.equal(p.release_targets.length,1); a.equal(p.release_targets[0].id,"main"); a.equal(p.release_targets[0].version,"2.3.2");'
checks.why: The default severity must reach CreateChangeFile.
Summary forwarding must write the user's actual release note.
A one-off changeset alone does not implement the reusable input mapping.
Recording intent must not prepare a release.
Evaluation is limited to local planning and preparation; registry, tag, release, and push operations are outside the task.
